latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of the Authority Signal Designer skill.

- Enables users to design and audit authority signals in content such as bios, about pages, and landing pages.
- Supports two modes: APPLICATION (designing authority signals) and DEFENSE (evaluating authority claims).
- Uses a structured process covering scenario analysis, audit of existing signals, authority strategy design, and ethical checks.
- Incorporates three authority symbol types (titles, clothes/uniforms, trappings) with compliance data and strategic self-deprecation.
- Guides users to gather necessary context and audience information, ensuring outputs are matched to trust and persuasion goals.
